children: Cantor Equity Partners I entered into a Sponsor Support and Fee Agreement with its sponsor, Cantor EP Holdings, which has agreed to vote its ordinary shares in favor of extending the company's business-combination deadline from January 8, 2027, to January 7, 2028, or an earlier date set by the board. If the extension is approved and the company completes a business combination before the extended deadline, the company will pay the sponsor a termination fee, reduced by specified outstanding transaction expenses and amounts owed under two sponsor promissory notes. The agreement supports the proposed extension and the company's continued pursuit of a business combination.
: Through the extended business-combination deadline of Jan 7 2028, or an earlier date set by the board
: Secure sponsor support for extending the business-combination deadline
